scope: Prompt/demo simulation for comparing batch-programming variants before changing Codex defaults.

tasks.name: Repo-visible file inventory with summaries
tasks.prompt_template: Inventory repo-visible paths from {path_manifest}, reduce them by extension and ownership, assert no duplicate paths, and write a compact evidence summary with artifact paths.

tasks.name: Normalize JSON fixtures and verify schema keys
tasks.prompt_template: Normalize {fixture_paths} as JSON, preserve schema keys, emit changed artifact paths, and assert required keys plus row counts before reporting success.

tasks.name: Markdown evidence audit and gap report
tasks.prompt_template: Audit {markdown_paths} against {evidence_paths}, separate verified facts from inferences, cite artifact paths, and produce a gap report with concrete follow-up criteria.

tasks.name: Small mechanical code/doc patch with assertions
tasks.prompt_template: Apply the same mechanical edit pattern to {target_paths}, keep unrelated changes intact, then run bounded assertions and summarize changed files plus verification commands.

tasks.name: One-off direct file check
tasks.prompt_template: Check {single_path} for one exact symbol or key, report whether it exists, and cite the line or JSON path using the simplest direct command that returns the fact.

interactive_sequential.notes_suffix: Micro-probe winner because direct inspection has less setup overhead.

focused_shell_batch.notes_suffix: Slightly overbuilt for one direct fact.

workflow_batch_inline.notes_suffix: Batch setup dominates a one-check task.

workflow_batch_spec_file.notes_suffix: Spec-file setup is not justified for one fact path.

python_script.notes_suffix: Script setup is reusable only after repeated probes.

delegated_worker_batch.notes_suffix: Delegation overhead dominates tiny deterministic work.

hybrid_scout_batch.notes_suffix: Scouting overhead is unnecessary when the exact path is known.

variants.label: Interactive sequential tools
variants.prompt: Inspect each file or query one at a time. Summarize after every result and decide the next command interactively.
variants.notes: Transparent, but slow and token-heavy on repeated deterministic operations.

variants.label: Focused shell/rg batch
variants.prompt: Use one focused shell batch for independent reads/searches, then inspect only the returned files that matter.
variants.notes: Good for read-only probes; weaker for structured transforms and per-step assertions.

variants.label: Inline workflow_batch spec
variants.prompt: Use workflow_batch for deterministic file/JSON reads, transforms, bounded scans, assertions, and a compact report.
variants.notes: Best canary path for repeated deterministic local work before promoting a reusable spec.

variants.label: Checked-in workflow_batch spec file
variants.prompt: Run a reviewed workflow_batch spec_path with named reports and assertions; update the spec only after a canary passes.
variants.notes: Fastest repeat path once the operation is stable; overkill for one-off probes.

variants.label: Purpose-built Python script
variants.prompt: Write or reuse a small Python runner for richer algorithms, fixture generation, or reusable metrics; emit JSON and Markdown reports.
variants.notes: Best for reusable metrics and richer data structures; initial setup cost is higher.

variants.label: Delegated worker batch
variants.prompt: Delegate an isolated implementation, review, or test triage packet with exact files, verification, and a short handoff.
variants.notes: Useful for parallel review or long-running tests; inefficient for tiny local deterministic work.

variants.label: Hybrid scout plus local batch
variants.prompt: Use first-moves/context scouting to choose exact files, then run workflow_batch or a script for deterministic operations.
variants.notes: Best general default when the file set is uncertain but the operation becomes deterministic after routing.
